explanation: The statement is a specific computation: t^(-5/2) * (sqrt(3t))^5 = 3^(5/2). Mathlib has only the ingredients (Real.mul_rpow, Real.rpow_neg, Real.rpow_natCast, Real.rpow_div_two_eq_sqrt, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow), and the proof combines several of them. I found no single Mathlib lemma that gives this identity. Getting it from those lemmas needs several steps (rewrite the sqrt power as an rpow, split the product, cancel), which is more than a one- or two-line derivation. I did not run a full grep of Mathlib.
